notes: Item 19 discloses annual gross sales for 2024 for 75 franchisees open a full calendar year. Two square-footage tier breakdowns are provided (over/under 10,000 sq ft). A detailed location-by-location table with 75 rows is provided showing city, state, months open, sq ft, 2024 gross sales, sales per sq ft, avg leads/month, private offices, and peak occupancy. System-wide sales growth bar chart covers 2019-2024. The median gross sales figure shown in the summary row ($80,757) appears to be an OCR error — given that the location-level data shows no individual location near that figure (minimum is $231,217), the true median is likely around $601K-$620K; this value is extracted as-is but flagged. Individual location records are not separately enumerated in the JSON to avoid excessive record count, but the aggregate stats (avg, median, min, max, pct above avg) are captured in the all_franchised record. The network-wide series records capture system totals only (no per-unit averages) as the bar chart does not disclose per-unit figures.
